questions.topic: eGurukul · Treatment Of Leprosy And Mac
questions.stem: A patient was on treatment for multibacillary leprosy for the last three months. Now the patient developed easy fatiguability, decreased interest in work, and pallor on examination. What drug is responsible for the patient's symptoms:
questions.solutionHtml:
Dapsone
  • It causes anemia and can increase/decompensate pre-existing anemia
  • If hemoglobin is less than ten gm%, start iron, folic acid, and ascorbic acid and advise the person to take a high protein diet along with MDT


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:832
